notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin and Born to Drive attached to Barrenton Medic.
Barrenton Medic does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Barrenton Medic by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
Activate Barrenton Medic by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
